name: resident_patch_script_semantics
purpose: Define and implement resident-mode patch/script semantics before allowing changing-input workloads to claim throughput.
weakest_point: The resident changing-input GPU and matching CPU gates pass with a bounded 512x32 GPU win, but this does not imply broad target-breadth or full RTL application throughput.

accepted_semantics.state_residency: The full state array remains device-resident across all resident eval steps.
accepted_semantics.initial_state_upload: The optional init-state upload is performed once before the resident loop begins.
accepted_semantics.patch_schedule_upload: Per-step patch changes are uploaded once as a compact schedule before the resident loop begins.
accepted_semantics.per_step_host_copy: No cuMemcpyHtoD patch copy may occur inside the resident step loop.
accepted_semantics.final_state_download: Final DtoH occurs only when --dump-state is requested.

patch_schedule_abi.host_input_text_format: Reuse the existing --patch-script text grammar as the source format.
patch_schedule_abi.device_schedule_encoding: A compact array of patch records plus per-step index metadata is prepared before resident execution.
patch_schedule_abi.empty_step_encoding: A step with '-' has zero records and still advances one resident eval step.
patch_schedule_abi.repeat_encoding: @repeat-seq blocks are expanded or indexed before resident execution; runtime semantics must be equivalent to the non-resident parser.
patch_schedule_abi.offset_scope: global_byte_offset is relative to the full device storage buffer, matching the current --patch syntax.

implementation_policy.phase_1: Keep rejecting direct --patch with --resident-steps because it is still a host argv per-step patch interface.
implementation_policy.phase_2: Allow --resident-steps with --patch-script by uploading the schedule once before launch and applying records with vl_apply_patch_schedule_gpu.
implementation_policy.phase_3: Consider direct --patch with --resident-steps only as a one-step schedule shorthand.
forbidden: per-step host-device patch copies in resident mode
changing non-resident --patch-script semantics while adding resident support
claiming resident changing-input throughput before a matching CPU baseline exists

next_semantics_axis.name: application_like_patch_schedule_semantics
next_semantics_axis.purpose: Move beyond arbitrary root byte patches toward input, ROM, or program-delta changes that can be explained as design-level stimuli.
next_semantics_axis.selection_reason: ROM or memory init deltas are closer to design-level stimuli than arbitrary root byte offsets while still fitting the one-time resident schedule upload model.

selected_semantic_contract.name: rom_or_memory_init_delta
selected_semantic_contract.host_source: a bounded list of memory-image byte deltas derived before resident execution
selected_semantic_contract.device_behavior: upload the delta schedule once, apply deltas on device before or during the resident loop, and avoid per-step host-device copies
selected_semantic_contract.cpu_baseline: matching single-process CPU exact-loop applies the same memory-image deltas before each corresponding eval step
selected_semantic_contract.allowed_claim: communication-reduced resident execution for a bounded ROM or memory initialization delta workload
selected_semantic_contract.current_limit: the first ROM/memory delta gate uses explicit root storage offsets as a proxy mapping
selected_semantic_contract.named_mapping_contract: XuanTie-E902 case.pat words map through tb.v mem_inst_temp into x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem with testbench initialization lanes ram0=word[31:24], ram1=word[23:16], ram2=word[15:8], ram3=word[7:0].
selected_semantic_contract.non_claim: not ISA/program correctness, not full software boot correctness, and not arbitrary root-byte patch semantics

non_goals: do not treat arbitrary root byte offsets as application semantics
do not claim ISA/program correctness from byte-patch throughput alone
do not reintroduce per-step host-device copies
